description: Session entry for ui-kit component discovery. Paths are relative to packages/ui-kit. The component inventory lives in the generated graph.json (from the manifests and contracts); nothing here duplicates it.

steps: edit source, contracts and manifest together

delivery.budgetScope: Serialized paged response including its envelope, UTF-8 bytes.
delivery.paging: Add --page 0 to any command for bounded pages. Each page has complete and next; run next.args until complete is true. The page sha256 binds the selection and its content: if a source changes mid-way the continuation fails; restart at --page 0.
delivery.completeFile: --out <new-file> writes the whole response and prints a receipt (path, sha256, bytes). The parent folder must exist; an existing file is refused. A receipt proves delivery, not reading.
